title: Please list the lowest three eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 in
question:
Please list the lowest three eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 in continuation schools.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

prediction.sql: SELECT frpm.XCL_026 FROM frpm JOIN schools ON "frpm".XCL_001 = "schools".XCL_041 WHERE schools.XCL_069 = 'Continuation High Schools' AND NOT frpm.XCL_026 IS NULL ORDER BY frpm.XCL_026 ASC LIMIT 3

arguments.sql:
SELECT frpm.XCL_026
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.XCL_001 = schools.XCL_041
WHERE schools.XCL_069 = 'Continuation Schools (Public)'
  AND frpm.XCL_026 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY frpm.XCL_026 ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT frpm.XCL_026
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.XCL_001 = schools.XCL_041
WHERE schools.XCL_069 = 'Continuation High Schools'
  AND frpm.XCL_026 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY frpm.XCL_026 ASC
LIMIT 3
